environment.scope: Repository-only / DARK. Prevents a TRANSIENT proxy/network failure from wasting the account-46 one-use attestation key while preserving EXACTLY-ONCE, fail-closed semantics. The pkt-138 live attempt hit HTTP 502 (a transient Traefik connection drop); the single POST never reached the verifier (window uses=0, CopierIngestNonce unchanged at 2), but run_oneshot shreds the host key on every path so the one-use key was spent. This change adds AUTHORITATIVE post-failure reconciliation (NOT a blind retry): after an AMBIGUOUS transport outcome the operator orchestration queries existing durable backend state - CopierVerifierWindow.uses (incremented when the key is CLAIMED, before the verdict) and CopierIngestNonce (burned only after a FULL verify) - and classifies PROCESSED_VERIFIED / PROCESSED_REJECTED / NOT_PROCESSED / AMBIGUOUS. Only a PROVEN NOT_PROCESSED permits a retry, at most ONCE, reprovisioning the SAME in-memory key (no second human prompt) into the still-OPEN window. A verifier HTTP verdict (200/400/401/403/409) is NEVER retried. NO migration (existing records suffice). NO deploy, host contact, real secret, verifier window, flag enablement, task trigger, account-48 contact or broker action.

expected_results: Reconciliation is authoritative, not a blind retry: after an ambiguous transport outcome the classifier returns NOT_PROCESSED (the ONLY retry signal) ONLY when the window is still OPEN, unexpired, uses==0 and the nonce is not burned; a burned nonce is PROCESSED_VERIFIED; uses>=1 without a burned nonce is PROCESSED_REJECTED; any missing/conflicting/unreadable evidence is AMBIGUOUS. Fail-closed throughout.

The operator orchestration retries AT MOST ONCE and ONLY from NOT_PROCESSED, reprovisioning the SAME in-memory key; it NEVER retries a verifier HTTP verdict (200/400/401/403/409); it guarantees teardown (in-memory key dropped, host key shredded, window closed) on every terminal path including an exception; it never contacts account 48 or any broker/execution endpoint.

Exactly-once preserved: the only retry-permitting state (NOT_PROCESSED) is proven from CopierVerifierWindow.uses==0 on a still-OPEN window; the retry reuses that window's UNCHANGED backend key, so the same key bytes reach host and verifier; the fresh attempt signs a NEW nonce (run_oneshot generates a uuid4 nonce per run), so replay protection and the single-use nonce burn are intact. copier_attest_reconcile is strictly read-only (creates no window/nonce - asserted).

Independent blind adversarial review (sub-agent) verdict: exactly-once and fail-closed HOLD (no duplicate processing, the only retry is gated on a proven NOT_PROCESSED/uses==0, every parse/read/unknown error degrades to AMBIGUOUS/None => no retry, no secret leak, replay intact). It found three safe-direction defects; two were fixed and one documented: F1 (fixed) - a LOST trigger RESULT after a successful POST was misreported as REJECTED; now _normalise_trigger_result uses host_contacted to split 'host never ran' (definitive REJECTED) from 'host ran, result lost' (AMBIGUOUS -> window-based reconcile by correlation, new PROCESSED_INDETERMINATE => UNKNOWN, never a false REJECTED and never retried). F2 (fixed) - teardown now covers the setup phase: provision + window-open + drive run under ONE guaranteed-teardown finally, so a provision/window-open exception still shreds the host key + closes the window (proven by test_drive_mode_teardown_on_provision_exception). F3 (documented, not weakened) - _last_json fails closed on trailing stdout noise (safe direction; the driven docker-exec/manage.py commands put JSON on stdout and warnings on stderr, read separately); the pkt-128 hardening is intentionally kept. A narrow sub-millisecond race between claim_key's uses-commit and the nonce-burn-commit could momentarily read a verified request as PROCESSED_REJECTED - this fails SAFE (processed => no retry; exactly-once intact) and is a documented limitation. Re-verified after the fixes: wrapper 40/40, reconcile 18/18, emitter+bundle+attest-verify green, governance-check EXIT 0.
limitations: PARTIAL (not PASS): the exact-head Linux CI (5 conclusions) and the separate windows-latest PowerShell 5.1 ParseFile + Pester gate are driven on CI runners against the pushed head; their run IDs and conclusions are recorded in the PR body and Notion, not inside this committed manifest (authored before those runs complete).

Repository-only / DARK. Auto-merge OFF; NOT merged, NOT deployed. Re-running the account-46 attestation with the new --drive-attestation path (real key entry, verifier window, flag enablement, task trigger) remains a SEPARATE Sponsor/human gate. No real secret handled in this packet.

The reconciliation distinguishes PROCESSED from NOT_PROCESSED authoritatively from existing records; it cannot recover the exact sanitised REJECTION sub-reason when the response was lost (the backend stores no per-request reason) - it reports PROCESSED_REJECTED (no retry), which is the safety-relevant fact. A future verified attempt whose response is NOT lost still surfaces the exact reason via the pkt-128 sanitised-reason path.
The Windows ParseFile/Pester gate validates the .ps1 provisioner bundle, which this PR does not change; it is re-run at the PR head as a no-regression confirmation.

Backend flags and the host emitter config gate return-to-DARK remain the agent's separate enable/teardown (unchanged); the wrapper's guaranteed teardown covers its own domain (in-memory key, host key, verifier window); the one-shot TASK is re-disabled host-side by the signed trigger.
